relationships.subject: cereblon
relationships.evidence_quote: PROTAC-mediated proximity between NaV1.8 and CRBN results in ubiquitination on the 2nd intracellular loop

relationships.subject: proteasome
relationships.evidence_quote: observed nearly complete blockade of degradation by BTZ but no effect of BafA

key_findings: Degron-tagged Nav1.8 and Nav1.7 are rapidly and nearly completely degraded by CRBN- and VHL-recruiting PROTACs/molecular glues via the proteasome (not lysosome) in cell lines.
LC/MS detected PROTAC-induced ubiquitination at K1100 in the second intracellular loop of Nav1.8.
